basic_info.description: Ultimate easy living by the beach!  Enjoy maximum convenience with a prime location just steps away from local favorites in every direction; Andytown, Outerlands, Hook Fish, The Beach, Devils Teeth, The Pizza Place and Gus's. Embrace the outdoors by walking, running, skating, or biking along the Great Highway, beach, and Golden Gate Park. Spend weekends at the Sunset Mercantile Farmer's Market or relax while watching sunsets with your neighbors.    The home features a desirable open layout with a sun drenched living room, large windows, and a fireplace. The open space flows into an impressively bright chef's kitchen, offering one of the best integrations and configurations around compared to the typical layout found. Quiet back bedrooms. The downstairs area is seamlessly integrated and provides ample space and versatility for work and leisure, featuring a finished family room/workout area, and a 3rd bedroom with a 2nd full bathroom, perfect for guest quarters or an au pair. The hardscaped backyard is low maintenance, allowing you to soak up the sun or enjoy the fresh coastal air.    One car garage with laundry and room on the sidewalk for just the right second car.     Perfect for a single-family home buyer seeking LOCATION and EASE!
